ASX Announcement 
 
 
 
 
 
30 July 2026 
Energy Technologies Limited 4Q FY2026 Quarterly 
Activities Report and Appendix 4C 
Key highlights: 
 
Successfully raised gross proceeds of $2.495m through the issue of 
124,746,500 shares via a placement at $0.02; 
 
First development contract with AFWERX (USA Airforce) and NASA 
providing validation for the Cogenic business; 
 
EGM announced to refresh capacity to raise further funds as needed to 
accelerate the Cogenic business plan; and 
 
Completed installation of new Cable Building software at the Rosedale 
factory.  
Energy Technologies Limited (ASX: EGY or “the Company”), is pleased to release its 
Quarterly Activities Report and Appendix 4C Quarterly Cash Flow Report for the period ended 
30th June 2026 (“4Q FY2026”). 
Cash receipts for the quarter were $849k, while net cash used in operating activities was 
$1.36m, consistent with the ongoing restructure and capital management plan.  
Subsequent to the last quarter, EGY was pleased to update its Shareholders that its 100% 
subsidiary, Cogenic Pty Limited (Cogenic), entered into an agreement with Amalgamated 
Vision to develop, inside a broader development project, Laser Beam Scanning solutions for 
both the US Airforce and NASA.  While the project does not have an immediate revenue event 
for the company, the affiliation with such strong names in our chosen target industries will 
greatly aid ongoing discussions globally with similar clients. The growth and maintenance 
capital spent in these sectors is highly attractive and given the end clients are government or 
government related parties the counter party risk and payment terms are quite favourable. 
EGY now believes that the investment in the original IP Portfolio and staff that have been 
contracted to execute on the business plan will show benefits to the company much earlier 
than first forecast and look forward to updating the market as these developments come to 
hand. 
Bambach Wires and Cables, a 100% subsidiary of EGY, continues to be restructured to 
ensure that it moves to cash flow break even and the newly installed cable building software 
at Rosedale will continue to aid this move. 
 
 
 
 
For personal use only

 
 
 
 
ASX Listing Rule 4.7C.3 
In accordance with ASX Listing Rule 4.7C, payments made to related parties included in item 
6.1 of the Appendix 4C incorporate director’s fees, salary and superannuation benefits. EGY 
paid a total of $29,166 in Director’s Fees to the related parties in this current quarter. 
EGY confirms that it conducted business as usual there were no substantive changes to it’s 
activities during 4Q FY2026. EGY’S primary activity is the manufacture and sale of specialist 
industrial cables and ancillary products through wholly owned subsidiary Bambach Wires and 
Cables Pty Ltd. 
 
– END – 
 
About Energy Technologies 
Energy Technologies Limited (ABN 38 002 679 469) specialises in energy technology. It provides solutions for 
industries and companies on efficiencies, usage and development for electricity and renewables.  Its operations 
include Bambach Wires and Cables Pty Limited (100% subsidiary) specializing in low voltage copper cables and 
renewable energy solutions, Dulhunty Engineering Limited (51% subsidiary), specializing in fiber distribution and 
Cogenic Pty Limited (100% subsidiary), specializing in Laser Optical Engineering.  
 
Learn more about Energy Technologies at website www.energytechnologies.com.au.
